key_insight: OMatG-FC generates new inorganic crystals by learning atomic identities and unit-cell volume while keeping the structural framework fixed.
engineering_relevance: Framework conditioning reduces the generation problem’s dimensionality, enabling materials discovery without learning atomic packings from scratch.
method: Fix fractional atomic coordinates and unit-volume lattice vectors.
Generate atomic species using discrete flow matching and scale lattice volume using stochastic interpolants.
Audit duplicate frameworks in MP-20 and provide a framework-split dataset.
evidence_signal: Evaluation with LeMat-GenBench and three ML interatomic potentials reports a state-of-the-art stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) rate below the convex hull, though the abstract gives no numerical rate.
watch_item: Fixed input frameworks constrain the structural search space, and ML-predicted stability requires higher-fidelity validation.
